records.name: wgpu
records.current_use: RHI device queue resource and submission implementation
records.boundary: Only meridian-rhi exposes Meridian-owned contracts to the rest of the engine
records.compatibility: Retain throughout native backend work until differential parity and exit gates pass
records.planned_alternative: Native Metal then Vulkan and Direct3D 12 behind the common RHI after research gates

records.name: Naga
records.purpose: WGSL parsing validation and shader translation foundation
records.current_use: Current shader validation in the wgpu-era renderer
records.boundary: Meridian Shader Language and ShaderIr own public semantics; Naga remains a target/compiler boundary
records.compatibility: Shader fixtures source maps reflection and backend differential output must remain stable
records.planned_alternative: PRG-SHD-001 only if measured product value and maintenance capacity justify internalization

records.name: winit
records.purpose: Current window input and event-loop platform foundation
records.current_use: Platform lifecycle window surface and input integration
records.boundary: meridian-platform maps platform events into engine-owned lifecycle and input contracts
records.compatibility: Lifecycle DPI input recovery and supported-platform behavior remain fixture tested
records.planned_alternative: Platform-specific adapters only where material capability or reliability evidence requires them

records.name: bevy_ecs
records.purpose: Current ECS storage scheduling and query foundation
records.current_use: Runtime world and schedule implementation beneath Meridian-owned gameplay contracts
records.boundary: Public gameplay save network editor and game schemas never expose Bevy entity or query types
records.compatibility: Stable entity identity scheduling save and replay behavior remain Meridian-owned
records.planned_alternative: No replacement planned without demonstrated product blocker and complete migration evidence

records.name: cosmic-text
records.purpose: Unicode text shaping fallback layout editing and rasterization behind Meridian UI contracts
records.current_use: MS-02 meridian-ui text adapter with default features disabled and std plus swash enabled
records.boundary: Meridian owns UiText UiTextLayout DisplayList semantics events diagnostics and persistence; cosmic-text types remain private to the adapter
records.compatibility: Unicode bidi fallback IME selection and glyph-layout fixtures must remain stable at the Meridian boundary across adapter updates
test_requirements: Glyph raster and device-loss recovery tests
records.planned_alternative: Reevaluate only through RG-UI-001 evidence and an adopted migration decision; do not expose adapter types

records.name: unicode-segmentation
records.purpose: Unicode extended grapheme boundaries for Meridian-owned text editing state
records.current_use: MS-02 meridian-ui text-input adapter for cursor movement, selection, deletion, and password masking
records.boundary: Meridian owns text-input events, positions, selections, clipboard requests, password policy, and snapshots; unicode-segmentation iterators remain private implementation detail
records.compatibility: Grapheme cursor, selection, deletion, composition, and password-redaction fixtures must remain stable across Unicode-data updates
records.planned_alternative: Reevaluate only through RG-UI-001 evidence; do not reimplement Unicode segmentation ad hoc

records.name: rfd
records.purpose: Native user-initiated project-directory selection behind the Meridian Creator hub adapter
records.current_use: MS-03 meridian-editor native picker adapter with default features disabled and the portable xdg-portal backend selected
records.boundary: Only meridian-editor invokes the private adapter after an explicit hub action; Meridian-owned paths, diagnostics, commands, and project validation cross the boundary
records.compatibility: Picker cancellation, directory-only selection, supported desktop behavior, and invalid-project remediation remain fixture tested without exposing rfd types
records.planned_alternative: Use a platform-owned directory picker only after a measured desktop capability or maintenance reason; do not add a custom picker now

records.name: AccessKit
records.purpose: Platform accessibility adapter for Meridian-owned semantic snapshots
records.license: accesskit MIT OR Apache-2.0; accesskit_winit Apache-2.0
records.current_use: WP-UI-005 private meridian-platform accessibility feature with accesskit 0.24.1 and accesskit_winit 0.33.2
records.boundary: Meridian owns roles names values actions relationships reading order live regions focus and recovery; AccessKit types remain private platform-adapter details
records.compatibility: Semantic tree focus action live-region scaling and platform screen-reader mappings remain stable at Meridian interfaces
records.planned_alternative: Use direct platform adapters only if measured AccessKit gaps cannot be corrected upstream without weakening Meridian semantics

records.name: Mona Sans
records.current_use: Planned for WP-UI-002 after exact font revision hashes notices and redistribution artifacts are recorded
records.boundary: Meridian owns font roles fallback scale metrics diagnostics and package manifests; font files remain immutable licensed assets
records.compatibility: Golden layout shaping fallback and 100 to 400 percent scale fixtures detect metric changes
records.planned_alternative: A replacement must preserve the locked interface role and pass the complete layout corpus

records.name: Hubot Sans
records.current_use: Planned for WP-UI-002 after exact font revision hashes notices and redistribution artifacts are recorded
records.boundary: Hubot Sans is restricted to display headings behind Meridian font-role identifiers and never becomes a control-text dependency
records.compatibility: Heading metrics remain covered at all supported scales and fallback states
records.planned_alternative: Use Mona Sans if Hubot packaging or readability cannot satisfy the heading corpus

records.name: JetBrains Mono
records.purpose: Meridian code log identifier measurement and technical-data typography
records.current_use: Planned for WP-UI-002 after exact font revision hashes notices and redistribution artifacts are recorded
records.boundary: Meridian owns code and technical text roles shaping editing metrics and fallback; the font remains an immutable licensed asset
records.compatibility: Code cursor selection table alignment ligature policy and scale fixtures remain stable
records.planned_alternative: A replacement must pass code editing and dense technical-data corpora without changing source semantics

records.name: Lucide SVG subset
records.purpose: Pinned application icon sources behind Meridian-owned icon identifiers
records.current_use: Planned for WP-UI-002 after selecting the minimal subset and recording exact upstream revision per-file hashes notices modifications and regeneration
records.boundary: Only Meridian IconId and renderer-neutral paths cross public boundaries; filenames SVG parser objects and upstream names remain private assets/adapters
records.compatibility: Accessible names visual snapshots path bounds high contrast and one-times/two-times raster output remain stable
records.planned_alternative: Custom Meridian domain icons cover missing concepts; replacement of the common subset requires visual and accessibility review

records.name: Rapier
records.current_use: Physics world collision query and constraint implementation beneath meridian-physics
records.boundary: Cairn owns public physics semantics provenance fixtures and future implementation choices
records.compatibility: Cairn differential fixtures and provenance control every replacement or borrowed algorithm
records.planned_alternative: Evidence-gated Cairn-owned implementations and provenance-controlled donor algorithms

records.name: rust-analyzer
records.purpose: Rust semantic editing and language-server foundation
records.current_use: Planned Meridian IDE semantic service through an isolated process boundary
records.boundary: Cargo and Rust source remain authoritative; Meridian owns sessions commands recovery and UI
records.compatibility: Track supported Rust toolchains protocol behavior diagnostics and process recovery
records.planned_alternative: No native replacement planned; add Meridian-specific indexing only where measured gaps remain

records.name: blake3
records.purpose: Compiled artifact, package, capture, and declared build-input content hashing
records.license: CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
records.current_use: Version 1.8.5 behind Meridian ArtifactHash, package verification, and meridian-build BuildId/file-hash contracts
records.boundary: Only Meridian-owned hash types cross engine and application boundaries; BLAKE3 crate types remain private
records.compatibility: Persist algorithm and format version beside every stored digest before any future replacement
records.planned_alternative: No replacement planned; any algorithm change requires versioned dual-read migration

records.name: png
records.purpose: Portable lossless encoding for visible validation captures
records.boundary: RHI returns tightly packed Meridian CapturedFrame data; PNG encoding never enters RHI or source authority
records.compatibility: Capture metadata and raw pixel hash remain authoritative if encoder output changes
records.planned_alternative: Optional future EXR or platform encoders outside the RHI when explicit format requirements exist
